description: Get one issue from tideways_list_issues in depth: the stack trace of its latest occurrence (first 15 frames) with the request it came from (URL, method, status, host, service), the transactions it occurred in with counts, and its occurrences per time bucket over the retention period. Use to point at the failing code, rank the affected endpoints, and say when the issue started, peaked or stopped. Pass the id and the type the issue was listed under.

detail.description: "concise" (default) returns a trimmed summary. "full" also includes the unmodified API response under "raw"; it can be very large.

issueId.description: Issue ID from issues[].id of tideways_list_issues

project.description: Tideways project as "project" or "organization/project". Defaults to the defaultProject that tideways_list_projects reports; call it for valid names.

type.description: Type the issue was listed under in tideways_list_issues

name: tideways_get_issue

durationMs.description: Slow SQL queries: duration of the query in ms; null for other types

annotations.description: Request context, e.g. http.url (without query string), http.method, http.status

stack.description: Stack trace in the order Tideways returns it, at most 15 frames

previousException.description: Previous (chained) exception of the frame as Tideways returns it, or null

stackTruncated.description: True when frames were cut; detail "full" returns the whole stack under "raw"

message.description: Last message or SQL, truncated to 2000 characters

occurrenceHistogram.description: Occurrences per time bucket over the retention period

occurrences.description: All occurrences since firstOccurred, not limited to any period

raw.description: Unmodified Tideways API response; present only when detail is "full".

title.description: Exception class, or the tables of a slow SQL query

transactions.description: Transactions that raised the issue, with their occurrence counts

title: Get issue
